studio.coursesIntro: Create your courses and follow their review and publication.
studio.noCourses: You don’t have any courses yet.
studio.noCoursesHint: Start with a title: everything else is filled in the editor.
studio.newCourseHint: A title and a language are enough to start.
studio.enrollments: {count, plural, =0 {No students} one {# student} other {# students}}
studio.notProfessorBody: Your account isn’t a professor account yet. Once your application is accepted, you can create your courses here.

banner.draft: Draft: this course isn’t visible yet. Complete it, then send it for review.
banner.in_review: In review: the Yekkola team is checking your course. It can’t be edited meanwhile.
banner.rejected: Your latest version was declined. Fix it, then send it for review again.
banner.live: Live: students see this version. To change it, start a new draft.
banner.live_draft: Live, with a draft: students see the live version until your changes are approved.
banner.live_in_review: Live, changes in review: students keep the current version until then.
banner.unpublished: Offline: no new enrolments; enrolled students keep their access.
banner.archived: Archived: only visible to students already enrolled.

studio.noDraftBody: The live version isn’t edited directly. Start a draft: it copies the current course, and your changes go live after review.
studio.startDraftHint: Copies the live version so you can change it; students see nothing until it is approved.
studio.readOnly: This version is in review and can’t be edited. Withdraw it from review to make changes.
studio.detailsIntro: What students read before enrolling. Reviewed before publication.
studio.descriptionHint: Who the course is for, what it covers, how it is organised.
studio.outcomesHint: 3 to 8 short sentences: “By the end, you will know…”.
studio.requirementsHint: Optional: what students need to know or have before starting.
studio.changelogHint: Optional: what changes compared with the live version (for the reviewer).
studio.coverHint: 16:9, at least 1280 × 720 pixels (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max).
studio.settingsIntro: Helps students find the course. Applied at once, without review.
studio.pricingIntro: Free or paid, in one of the available currencies.

priceModeHints.free: One-tap enrolment: great for building an audience.

studio.priceInvalid: Enter an amount, for example 15 or 15.50.
studio.pricingGoingForward: A price change applies at once, to new orders only: enrolled students keep their access.
studio.curriculumIntro: Organise the course in sections and lessons. Drag the handles to reorder; every change is saved right away.
studio.noSectionsHint: Add a first section, then its lessons.
studio.emptySection: No lessons in this section. Add one or drag one here.
studio.deleteSectionHint: {count, plural, one {Its lesson will be deleted too.} other {Its # lessons will be deleted too.}}
studio.previewHint: Visible without enrolling, to win students over (at most {max} per course).
studio.deleteLessonHint: Its content will be removed from this draft.
studio.fileTooBig: This file is over the maximum size ({size}).

media.processing: File received, processing… This can take a few minutes.
media.errored: Processing failed. Please upload the file again.
media.erroredWith: Processing failed ({error}). Please upload the file again.
media.unfinished: An earlier upload didn’t finish. Choose the file again.
